heroText: Tofino works best as a base in Canada when you anchor days around Long Beach, Chesterman Beach and Cox Bay. Use those sights to understand the city's history, street life and visitor rhythm. Tofino / Long Beach Airport (YAZ) handles the main arrival flow, so hotel choice should balance the centre, transfer time and day-trip plans.

stayOverview: Start with City centre for the easiest first Tofino stay, then compare Old Town and Waterfront when price, nightlife, quieter evenings or transfer timing matter more than being beside every major sight.
hotelIntro: Tofino hotel choice is mostly about repeat journeys: use City centre for sightseeing, Old Town for a different local base, and Waterfront or Airport area when views, parking, airport timing or longer stays matter.
